title: Reel four opens; musicians reading music for nightclub acts
summary: Dick Allen announces the fourth reel. Albert resumes a fragment about musicians who could read music for nightclub performers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Yeah, okay, this is the fourth reel, Don Albert, May the 27th, 1972.

Okay, we were talking about, you had to read the poems. The band, as I told you previously, the musicians in those days, they played music. There weren't too many Finnish musicians that had learned music. So when Tra would get these jobs in these nightclubs that required music to be played for the performers such as.
